theorem pals_kernel_injective {G H : Type*} [Group G] [Group H]
    (f : G →* H) (hker : ∀ x, f x = 1 → x = 1) : Function.Injective f := by
  intro a b hab
  have h : f (a * b⁻¹) = 1 := by
    rw [map_mul, map_inv, hab, mul_inv_cancel]
  have h' : a * b⁻¹ = 1 := hker (a * b⁻¹) h
  exact mul_inv_eq_one.mp h'

theorem pals_sequence_limit_addition (u v : ℕ → ℝ) (a b : ℝ)
    (hu : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, |u n - a| < ε)
    (hv : ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, |v n - b| < ε) :
    ∀ ε > 0, ∃ N : ℕ, ∀ n ≥ N, |(u n + v n) - (a + b)| < ε := by
  intro ε hε
  obtain ⟨Nu, hNu⟩ := hu (ε / 2) (by linarith)
  obtain ⟨Nv, hNv⟩ := hv (ε / 2) (by linarith)
  refine ⟨max Nu Nv, ?_⟩
  intro n hn
  have hau := hNu n (le_trans (le_max_left _ _) hn)
  have hav := hNv n (le_trans (le_max_right _ _) hn)
  calc
    |(u n + v n) - (a + b)| = |(u n - a) + (v n - b)| := by ring_nf
    _ ≤ |u n - a| + |v n - b| := abs_add_le _ _
    _ < ε := by linarith

theorem pals_coprime_product_divisibility (a b n : ℕ)
    (hab : Nat.Coprime a b) (ha : a ∣ n) (hb : b ∣ n) : a * b ∣ n := by
  obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ := ha
  have hbk : b ∣ k := by
    apply hab.symm.dvd_of_dvd_mul_left
    rw [← hk]
    exact hb
  obtain ⟨m, hm⟩ := hbk
  refine ⟨m, ?_⟩
  rw [hk, hm, Nat.mul_assoc]

theorem pals_linear_kernel_sum {K V W : Type*} [Field K]
    [AddCommGroup V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module K V] [Module K W]
    (f g : V →ₗ[K] W)
    (hdisjoint : ∀ w, w ∈ LinearMap.range f → w ∈ LinearMap.range g → w = 0) :
    LinearMap.ker (f + g) = LinearMap.ker f ⊓ LinearMap.ker g := by
  ext x
  constructor
  · intro hx
    change f x + g x = 0 at hx
    have hfx : f x = 0 := by
      apply hdisjoint (f x) ⟨x, rfl⟩
      refine ⟨-x, ?_⟩
      simp only [map_neg]
      exact (eq_neg_of_add_eq_zero_left hx).symm
    constructor
    · exact hfx
    · change g x = 0
      rw [hfx, zero_add] at hx
      exact hx
  · rintro ⟨hf, hg⟩
    change f x + g x = 0
    change f x = 0 at hf
    change g x = 0 at hg
    rw [hf, hg, add_zero]
